selection_rule: Choose the lowest-priority-number action whose gate is incomplete, prerequisites are satisfied, the action is not owner-deferred, and the action is safe to execute with current standing authorization. If the earliest finishline action is deferred by owner, select the earliest parallel_safe action instead without closing or downgrading the deferred gate.

actions.title: Restore Admin-Policy und Host revalidieren
actions.instruction: Resume the deferred runner-group administrator evidence with the owner, then run secret-free Host Toolchain Readiness and advance only with current evidence.

actions.title: Mobile externen Restpfad read-only reconciliieren
actions.instruction: Reconcile current repository, Supabase redirect contract, EAS resource contracts, signing prerequisites and device/store runbooks. Do not create credentials, sign, submit or mutate external resources without the required owner/platform step.

actions.title: KI/Billing Restpunkte gegen aktuellen Staging-Lifecycle abgleichen
actions.instruction: Map old Gate-4 checkboxes to current Stripe Test catalog, entitlements, webhook/lifecycle code and existing evidence. Produce only the true remaining product, quality, cost and external-decision gaps; do not activate paid tiers.

actions.title: Meta/Security technischen Restpfad vorbereiten
actions.instruction: Reconcile Pixel/no-PII/security tests, Meta foundations and current non-Social smoke evidence. Keep Events Manager, App Review and provider-account acceptance external.

actions.title: Historische FanMind-Issues gegen aktuelle Evidence abbauen
actions.instruction: Map stale checkboxes in historical finishline/P1 issues to current evidence, mark genuinely superseded statements and retain only real remaining gaps. Do not recreate implementation merely because an old box is unchecked.

actions.title: Phase 3 Social real abnehmen
actions.instruction: Proceed only when non-Social prerequisite gates are accepted; then use existing Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp foundations and current provider evidence.

actions.title: Phase 7 Social real abnehmen
actions.instruction: Verify current official platform scope before each connector. No scraping, self-bot, reverse engineering or paid X usage without separate approval.

actions.title: Finalen Production-Demo- und Sales-Handoff schließen
actions.instruction: Run exact-release five-minute Production demo, synchronize sales truth and perform technical handoff only after all required gates are accepted.
